m.def: someone who intervenes with authorities for a person in trouble (usually using underhand or illegal methods for a fee)
the accessories that normally accompany (something or some activity)
ex: an elaborate formal dinner with all the fixings

m.def: an object firmly fixed in place (especially in a household)
a firework that fizzes as it moves
an effervescent beverage (usually alcoholic)
hissing and bubbling
